newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends flat, market focuses on T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends flat, market focuses on T-bills.

text.p: 1245 GMT - The Romanian leu closed pinned at 7,050/100 to the dollar on Tuesday on a dollar flush interbank market, traders said.

* Traders said larger dollar inflows came from growing foreign interest in Romanian stock markets, which prompted the central bank (BNR) repeatedly to purchase dollars over the past month to contain a sharp firming of the leu currency.

* Dealers said news that the BNR's foreign exchange reserves jumped to $1.45 billion in April from $853.7 million in March on the back of dollar purchases and fresh credits from the International Monetary Fund failed to impress on trading.
* In the money market, traders focused on the auction for three-month T-bills, whose annual yield they saw near 100 percent. Results of the auction were not immediately available.
* Leu's rates at currency retail shops lingered near 6,800/7,000 to the dollar.
